title: YouGov Survey: Zero-Sum Thinking
text:
Sample 1134 U.S. adult citizens Conducted April 4 - 9, 2025 Margin of Error ± 4.1%

1. Which comes closest to your view? 
Our lives are threatened by terrorists, criminals, and illegal immigrants and our priority should 
be to protect ourselves. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .32% 
It’s a big, beautiful world, mostly full of good people, and we must find a way to embrace each 
other and not allow ourselves to become isolated. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 54% 
Not sure . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . 14%
